capabilities: Create timestamped journal entries under year/month/day headings
Navigate entries via a month calendar and a file-explorer-style date tree
Filter and fuzzy-search entries by tag, date, title, and body text
Style the journal file with heading hierarchy, tag pills, and hidden Org syntax
extras: Requires installing and enabling the separate Org Reader plugin (which replaces Orgmode (cm6)); installation is manual via copying plugin files into the vault, and BRAT is mentioned as an install route.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in journal that keeps all dated entries in one Org-mode datetree file instead of separate daily Markdown notes.

relations.evidence: Works alongside Org Reader, which provides the .org editor view

summary: Date-tree journal in a single Org file with new-entry capture, calendar and tree navigation, tag filtering, and a styled journal view.
